summary: Duplicate externalId collision prevents privileged runbook access after org merge
description:
Issue summary: After a company org merge, several engineers can authenticate via Okta SSO successfully but lose elevated runbook permissions.
Impact: ~8 engineers in Platform team cannot run privileged runbooks; blocks incident response and oncall rotations for a 2-hour window.
Environment: prod (us-west) using standard Okta->SCIM provisioning to internal identity service; RBAC assigns roles based on identity.externalId mapping.
Steps to reproduce:
1) Ensure user has active Okta account with same email across merged orgs.
2) Trigger SCIM provisioning sync for the affected user.
3) Observe provisioning events and RBAC role assignment.
Observed behavior: Okta session establishes and user can log into console. However RBAC shows only "base-user" role; privileged roles (runbook-admin, incident-runner) not present. SCIM logs show two distinct SCIM profiles created for the same email with different externalId values (one from legacy org). The identity service performs an externalId uniqueness check and silently prefers the first-migrated profile, causing a role not to be applied to the active session.
Expected behavior: SCIM provisioning should consolidate duplicates or map alternateExternalIds such that the active SSO-authenticated identity receives the expected roles.
Relevant logs / artifacts:
- SCIM event IDs: scim-evt-20260312-7743 (legacy profile creation), scim-evt-20260312-7751 (merge/provision), scim-queue-id: q-42.
- Okta user profile ids: okta|u-99823 (legacy), okta|u-99823-org2 (merged). externalId fields differ.
- RBAC audit trace: rbac-audit-20260312-88 shows role assignment skipped with reason "externalId_conflict".
Attachments: debug bundle uploaded to S3: s3://redwood-support-debug/INT-874321/bundle-20260312.tar.gz
investigation_notes: 03/12 11:05 - Priya Nair: Initial report from Platform oncall; documented affected users and shared SCIM/Okta IDs.
03/12 11:30 - Liam Chen: Confirmed Okta auth successful; reproduced missing roles by impersonating affected account.
03/12 12:10 - SRE (Maya Ortiz): Found two SCIM identity records for same email; identity service enforces externalId unique constraint and ignores later mappings.
03/12 13:00 - Identity eng (Daniel Park): Hypothesis: legacy org used a different externalId namespace (orgA|<id>) and merge preserved both. RBAC role reconciliation runs at provision time only.
03/12 14:20 - Liam Chen: Created temporary reconciliation script to re-associate legacy externalId to primary identity for 7 affected users; roles restored for 5/7 immediately.
workaround: Manual reconciliation: identity team ran a one-off job that merged externalId namespaces for affected users and retriggered RBAC reconciliation; temporary fix applied to 7 users. For oncall gap, granted temporary runbook-admin to two fallback responders until reconciliation.
resolution: In progress - temporary reconciliation applied; working on durable fix to avoid silent externalId collisions.
next_steps:
1) Identity team to implement detection for duplicate externalId during SCIM sync and emit warning events (ETA 2026-03-18).
2) Update provisioning runbook to include automatic secondaryExternalId mapping for merged orgs.
3) Run full audit to find other duplicate externalId cases and reconcile.
4) Postmortem and update docs in Confluence with mapping guidance.
